events.title: Tavern Brawl
events.text: {name} started a brawl at the tavern last night. The owner wants damages.

success.resultText: You count out 25 gold. The owner grunts.
{name} pays up, glaring at you all morning.
The owner can't prove a thing.

failure.resultText: The watch has witnesses. 50 gold and a lot of embarrassment.

events.title: A Sick Mother
events.text: {name} asks for a 30 gold advance. Their mother is sick, they say.

success.resultText: {name} will remember this.
{name} says nothing, which is worse.
There's a letter and everything. You pay, a little ashamed.

failure.resultText: There is no mother. There is, however, a dice game.

events.title: Closing-Down Sale
events.text: The cleric is closing shop and selling off potions cheap.

success.resultText: The party drinks deep.
You keep your gold.

events.title: A Goblin Envoy
events.text: A nervous goblin envoy offers 40 gold if your party takes the day off tomorrow.

success.resultText: Easy money, until the Queen's spies hear of it: next tribute +25.
The party likes a boss with principles.
{name} drags back the envoy's purse.

events.title: Creative Accounting
events.text: A forger offers receipts that would make 60 gold of expenses vanish from the books.

success.resultText: Flawless work. You almost miss your old job.

failure.resultText: The auditor squints at the receipts. Next tribute +100.

success.resultText: The watch pays a small reward.
You've been in enough trouble.

events.title: Mortimer Quill
events.text: Mortimer Quill, the accountant who framed you, arrives in town and offers his 'help'.

choices.label: Pay him to talk to the auditor

success.resultText: Quill knows the auditor well. Next tribute -60.
The party cheers as he lands in the mud.
Quill pays to keep his own secrets.

failure.resultText: Quill writes to the Queen first. Next tribute +80.

events.title: A Stray Dog
events.text: A scruffy dog has followed the party home.

success.resultText: The party is smitten. The dog eats like a hoblin.
It looks back once. Just once.

events.title: Dice in the Dark
events.text: {name} wants to stake 30 of the party's gold on a 'sure thing' dice game.

success.resultText: Double or nothing, and it's double!

failure.resultText: It was not a sure thing.

success.resultText: {name} sulks.

events.title: Last Night's Tab
events.text: {name} drank the tavern dry and left the tab in your name.

success.resultText: {name} raises a shaky thumbs-up.
{name} spends the morning groaning.

events.title: A Wandering Healer
events.text: A wandering healer offers to see to the party for 20 gold.

success.resultText: Her poultices smell awful and work wonders.
She moves on to the next town.

events.title: Bandit Toll
events.text: Bandits block the road back to town and demand a toll.

success.resultText: They count it twice and wave you through.
The bandits flee, dropping their own purse.

failure.resultText: You get through, but it hurts.

events.title: A Lost Ledger
events.text: You find a merchant's lost ledger, full of interesting numbers.

success.resultText: The merchant pays a small reward.
Profitable, and noticed: next tribute +15.

events.title: A Union Meeting
events.text: {name} has called a union meeting. The party wants better conditions.

success.resultText: Solidarity is expensive.
The meeting ends in muttering.
{name} will not forget this.

events.title: A Letter from Court
events.text: The Queen has written to her nephew, {name}, asking how you treat him.

choices.label: Buy him gifts before he replies

success.resultText: He writes glowingly. Next tribute -60.

choices.label: Let him write what he likes

success.resultText: He's fond of you, apparently. Next tribute -30.

failure.resultText: He complains about the food. Next tribute +40.

events.title: A Lucky Charm
events.text: A merchant swears this rabbit's foot will keep the party safe. 25 gold.

success.resultText: Nobody believes in it. Everyone touches it before a fight.
Ten gold. You've still got it.

failure.resultText: The merchant is insulted and leaves.

success.resultText: You keep your gold and your skepticism.

events.title: Restless Dead
events.text: {name} swears they saw a ghost last night and won't stop shaking.

success.resultText: The priest chants. {name} sleeps.
{name} faces their fear, and comes back stronger.

failure.resultText: {name} hasn't been the same since. Branded Cowardly.

events.title: An Old Knight
events.text: A retired knight offers to train {name} for 35 gold.

success.resultText: {name} learns a thing or two.
The knight shrugs and returns to his ale.

events.title: The Town Tax
events.text: The town's own tax collector wants 5% of your gold. Taxes, of all things.

success.resultText: The irony is not lost on you.
You find three errors in his maths. He leaves empty-handed.

failure.resultText: He finds four in yours. Double, plus a fine.

events.title: Found Goods
events.text: {name} offers to fence some goods they 'found'. There's 40 gold in it for you.

success.resultText: Now you're partners in crime. {name} gets ideas.
{name} returns the goods, grumbling.

events.title: Feast Day
events.text: It's a feast day in town. The party looks at you hopefully.

success.resultText: A night they'll talk about for weeks.

choices.label: They can celebrate on their own wages

success.resultText: Fair, but cold.

events.title: A Mauled Villager
events.text: The party finds a villager mauled by goblins on the road.

success.resultText: Word of your kindness reaches court. Next tribute -20.
Nobody speaks the rest of the way.

events.title: The Armorer's Offer
events.text: An armorer offers {name} a fitted shield for 40 gold.

success.resultText: {name} is noticeably harder to kill. +1 Constitution.
Maybe next week.

events.title: A Better Blade
events.text: The weaponsmith has a blade that would suit {name}. 35 gold.

success.resultText: {name} swings it with delight. +1 Might.
{name} looks at it longingly on the way out.

events.title: Rumours of Desertion
events.text: Word is {name} has been asking about work with another company.

success.resultText: {name} stays, and costs more.
Just a misunderstanding.
Rumours are just rumours. Probably.

events.title: A Goblin Prisoner
events.text: The party has caught a goblin scout. It's surprisingly chatty.

success.resultText: Its tribe pays. The party thinks it's a bit grim.
It tells you where the goblins keep their gold. Tomorrow's job pays 25% more.
It waves. Weird.

events.title: A Quiet Night
events.text: A rare quiet night. {name} teaches the others a song about the Queen. It is not flattering.

success.resultText: You know all the words. Suspicious.

events.title: Rats in the Stores
events.text: Rats got into the party's food stores overnight.

success.resultText: Fresh bread, and a cat.
Nobody eats well today.

events.title: Caught Cheating
events.text: {name} was caught cheating at cards. The other players want 30 gold back.

success.resultText: Settled, quietly.

choices.label: Let {name} spend a night in jail

success.resultText: {name} returns bruised and resentful.
Partners in crime again.

events.title: A Rival Recruiter
events.text: A rival company is trying to poach {name}.

success.resultText: {name} stays, for a price.
{name} stays. They liked being asked.
{name} leaves. The rival pays you a finder's fee.

events.title: The Herald's Inspection
events.text: The Queen's herald arrives early to inspect your books.

success.resultText: He likes what he sees. Next tribute -50.
Immaculate. Next tribute -25.

failure.resultText: He finds the coffee stains. Next tribute +50.

events.title: A Purse in the Road
events.text: {name} finds a fat purse lying in the road.

success.resultText: Finders keepers.
The owner gives a reward, and the party feels good about it.

events.title: A Pay Dispute
events.text: {name} says the others earn more for less work.

success.resultText: {name} is mollified.

choices.label: Everyone is paid what they're worth

success.resultText: {name} disagrees, loudly.

events.title: Field Supplies
events.text: {name} wants 20 gold for bandages and herbs.

success.resultText: {name} patches everyone up.
{name} sighs and tears up a shirt.

events.title: The Goblin Festival
events.text: The goblins are holding some kind of festival. Their nests are empty.

success.resultText: Easy pickings, if a little petty.
Even goblins deserve a day off, the party decides.
